ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, students will create an escape room that will open/launch in April 2024. After the student-supported run for two weeks in April, it will transfer operationally to CU Adventures in Time and Space where it will run in their space for up to two years. This course is by permission of the instructor. Interested students should complete the form at https://go.illinois.edu/wish
